description: This file contains utility functions for Kubernetes health checks, log processing, system metrics collection, network connectivity testing, and reporting. It is part of a health check or monitoring system for a Kubernetes-based environment, involving interaction with kubeconfig, pods, nodes, and external monitoring systems like Kafka and Loki.

classes.name: HealthResult
classes.description: Data class representing the structured health report containing site info, node and pod details, connectivity status, metrics, overall health status, and summary.

methods.name: logging.Logger setup_logging(level: str = "INFO")
methods.description: Initializes and returns a configured logger based on the provided log level.

methods.name: str fetch_kubeconfig_from_vault(vault_addr: str, token: str, secret_path: str, timeout: float = 8.0)
methods.description: Fetches kubeconfig content from HashiCorp Vault KV secret storage.

methods.name: Tuple[client.CoreV1Api,client.AppsV1Api] build_k8s_client_from_kubeconfig(kubeconfig_content: str)
methods.description: Creates Kubernetes API clients (CoreV1Api, AppsV1Api) from kubeconfig content.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_nodes(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, label_selector: str)
methods.description: Lists Kubernetes nodes with their status and labels.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_pods(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, label_selector: str)
methods.description: Lists pods in a namespace with container statuses.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _parse_metrics_from_text(log_text: str)
methods.description: Parses radio access metrics from logs.

methods.name: Tuple[int,str,str] _safe_exec_command(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod: str, container: str, command: List[str], timeout_seconds: int = 8)
methods.description: Executes a command in a Kubernetes container, capturing output and exit status.

methods.name: Optional[float] _parse_cpu_from_top(output: str)
methods.description: Parses CPU utilization percentage from 'top' command output.

methods.name: Dict[str,Optional[float]] _parse_mem_from_free(output: str)
methods.description: Parses memory usage details from 'free -m' output.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _parse_df_h(output: str)
methods.description: Parses disk usage information from 'df -h' command output.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _parse_sctp_ss(output: str)
methods.description: Detects SCTP socket presence from 'ss' command output.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _collect_container_system_metrics(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Collects CPU, memory, disk, and SCTP metrics from each container in a pod via command execution.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] collect_logs_and_metrics(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], max_bytes: int = 50000)
methods.description: Collects logs, radio metrics, and container system metrics, also identifies anomalies.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] tcp_connectivity_check(host: Optional[str], port: int, timeout: float)
methods.description: Checks TCP reachability and latency to a specified host and port.

methods.name: HealthResult build_health_report( site_id: Optional[str], environment: str, nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]], pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], connectivity: Dict[str, Any], metrics: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Aggregates system state, connectivity, and metrics into a structured health report.

methods.name: None send_to_kafka(bootstrap_servers: str, topic: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Sends the health report payload to a Kafka topic.

methods.name: None push_to_loki(loki_url: str, tenant_id: Optional[str], labels: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Pushes logs and entries to Loki for centralized logging.

methods.name: Optional[float] _num_from(s: str)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: delivery(err, msg)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: Dict[str,str] parse_labels(labels_str: str)
methods.description: unavailable
